defects.description: The term “Resolution” must be rendered as the required glossary equivalent “Резолюция”, not as “разрешение”.
The term “Finding” must be translated using the glossary equivalent “Вывод”, but the translation uses “находок/находка”.
The term “Documenter” is left untranslated in several places; according to the glossary it must be rendered as “Документатор”.
Typographical/grammatical error: the phrase “НЕ ДОЛЖНОВ” is incorrect Russian; it should be “НЕ ДОЛЖЕН”.
